name: Amtrak Guest Rewards

apr.notes: 26.49% variable APR. Official FNBO Summary of Credit Terms is JS-rendered; APR confirmed via third-party reviews citing official terms. Balance Transfer Fee: $10 or 5%, whichever is greater.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside the United States.

credit_required.notes: Not specified on the official FNBO product page.

rewards.redemption_notes: Points redeemable for Amtrak travel, upgrades, dining, gift cards via Amtrak Guest Rewards program. 5% points rebate when redeeming points for Amtrak travel. Points do not expire as long as account remains open and in good standing.

signup_bonus.description: Earn up to 20,000 bonus points: 15,000 points after spending $1,000, plus 5,000 points after adding an authorized user. All within first 3 billing cycles. Apply by 9/2/26.

benefits.title: 10% Rebate on Onboard Food and Beverage
benefits.description: 10% rebate on Amtrak onboard food and beverage purchases as statement credit.

benefits.title: 5% Points Rebate on Amtrak Travel Redemptions
benefits.description: 5% points rebate when redeeming points for Amtrak travel.

benefits.title: Points Don't Expire
benefits.description: Points do not expire as long as account remains open and in good standing.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside the United States.

other: No premium travel perks on the standard card (companion coupon, one-class upgrade, and station lounge pass are Preferred-only benefits)

notes: Issued by FNBO. $0 annual fee. No foreign transaction fees. Standard Amtrak Guest Rewards Mastercard (not Preferred).
